page_title: STU 2-1 MAI | Stuttgart v Mainz 26/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Felix Zwayer shows a yellow card to Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+8' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.
90+8' That's it for today, Felix Zwayer has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+8' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net.
90+8' Armindo Sieb (Mainz) takes the corner with a short pass.
90+7' Armindo Sieb (Mainz) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. It will be a corner kick for Mainz.
90+7' Paul Nebel (Mainz) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
90+4' Paul Nebel (Mainz) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
90+2' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) hits a shot towards the right side of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Robin Zentner.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
89' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Mainz comes to nothing.
87' We are about to witness a substitution. Nelson Weiper (Mainz) is replacing Stefan Bell.
87' Bo Henriksen prepares a substitution. Jae-Sung Lee is replaced by Arnaud Nordin (Mainz).
81' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
81' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Silvan Widmer as he is replaced by Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz).
79' 2 - 1 GOAL! Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Robin Zentner, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 2:1.
79' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) heads on.
77' The foul by Lorenz Assignon (VfB Stuttgart) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Felix Zwayer.
75' The shot by Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Robin Zentner.
75' Dan-Axel Zagadou is being substituted because of an injury. Sebastian Hoeness sends Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) on the pitch.
73' The linesman raises his flag. Armindo Sieb (Mainz) is adjudged offside.
72' Substitution. Chris Fuhrich makes way for Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart).
72' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to make a change. Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Jamie Leweling.
71' The resulting set piece from Stuttgart is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
67' Bo Henriksen has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) replacing Dominik Kohr.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Benedict Hollerbach trots off the pitch and is replaced by Armindo Sieb (Mainz).
66' Stefan Bell (Mainz) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
65' Finn Jeltsch (VfB Stuttgart) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
65' Stuttgart failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

64' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Corner kick. Stuttgart will have an opportunity.
63' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
62' Here is a change. Nikolas Nartey is going off and Sebastian Hoeness gives the last tactical orders to Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart).
62' It will be a substitution. Lorenz Assignon (VfB Stuttgart) is ready to enter the pitch as Pascal Stenzel walks off.
60' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
59' Felix Zwayer shows the yellow card to Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) for a heavy challenge.
58' The corner is swung in but Mainz can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
55' Danny da Costa (Mainz) gets inside the box and tries to beat Alexander Nubel with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
51' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) is adjudged offside.
49' Danny da Costa (Mainz) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
47' The game is interrupted now, Danny da Costa (Mainz) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
47' Stuttgart can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

46' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart), whose effort would probably have ended in the roof of the net. The ball goes out for a corner. Stuttgart can continue in their attacking effort.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+4' 1 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom right corner. Robin Zentner just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:1.
45+2' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
45+1' Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Dan-Axel Zagadou (VfB Stuttgart) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Robin Zentner.
43' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) is flagged for offside.
41' 0 - 1 Goal! Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) puts the ball into the left side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Alexander Nubel.
41' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
41' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Mainz!
40' There's a break in play and referee Felix Zwayer must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Mainz using VAR. This could be interesting!
39' That looked a certain handball by Chema Andres (VfB Stuttgart) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
37' The game is interrupted as Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) is flagged offside.
37' Dan-Axel Zagadou (VfB Stuttgart) watches the corner all the way, but places his header a whisker wide of the left post from close range.
36' Stuttgart earn a corner.
36' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
34' A player from Stuttgart commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
34' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Stuttgart.
34' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
27' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the left post.
27' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
27' Paul Nebel (Mainz) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
23' Danny da Costa (Mainz) gets on the end of the free kick and unleashes a header. The effort is not accurate enough and goes well wide of the left post.
20' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) produces a header from inside the penalty area, but he doesn't manage to hit the ball properly and it flies well wide of the left post.
19' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) shows good awareness inside the box, but his attempt is stopped by the goalkeeper.
13' Stuttgart take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

13' A header by Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) from very close range goes towards the crossbar, but doesn't get past Robin Zentner, who makes a brilliant save. The ball is out of play and Stuttgart manage to earn a corner.
9' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
7' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) is caught offside!
5' A promising first-time strike from inside the box by Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz), but his attempt goes just wide of the target.
5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Stuttgart.
1' The linesman signals that Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Mainz will have the kick-off.
Felix Zwayer will officiate today.
